Products

What is Multimilla?

Multimilla is your top app for managing daily financial activities—all in one convenient place. Enjoy features like instant deposits, withdrawals, contributions, bill payments, and card payments.

Is it possible to earn money with Multimilla?

Yes, from the Multimilla Contribution Cycle. It’s a system where individuals unite in a continuous cycle. You receive payments solely from the contributions that come in after you reach position one in your cycle.

How can I download the Multimilla app?

The Multimilla app can be downloaded on both the App Store and Google Play Store.

Is it secure to pay bills with Multimilla?

Yes, it’s safe. At Multimilla,we employ robust security measures to safeguard your personal information and transactions when paying bills. You can use our system with total confidence.

Which bills can I pay with Multimilla?

With Multimilla, you can conveniently pay a wide range of bills, including airtime, data, electricity, internet, TV, cable, and more. We are constantly expanding our list of billers to further enhance your payment experience.
